purchase_url_note: checkout_url is a Tutu deeplink that 301-redirects to this exact ticket's purchase page (cheapest fare family of the chosen offer; for a different fare override `offer_hash` with the selected `variants[i].offer_hash`). If the offer becomes unavailable, the deeplink falls back to the avia search results instead of breaking. The deeplink requests the passenger composition you passed (`passengers_full/child/infant`); tell the user to confirm the passenger count in the cart before paying.
